_about: Retrieval eval seed — query→expected-note pairs run against the reference vault (examples/reference-vault). Measures today's heuristic lookup so the E4 SQLite/FTS5 build stays trigger-gated (D6/F2): if the paraphrase-miss rate here crosses the agreed threshold, the scale tier is warranted; until then the deferral is evidence-based, not assumed. `kind`: 'literal' = words that appear in the note (title/tag/body); 'paraphrase' = a synonym/rephrase that shares few surface words (the F2 blind spot heuristic search is expected to miss). `expects` = vault-relative path that SHOULD rank in the top-k.
